question: How is the divine lotus of the first octad described in meditation?
premises: The lotus is described as divine.
It has eight spokes or petals.
It is adorned by the first octad.
inference: The meditation presents a divine eight-spoked lotus adorned by the first octad.
uncertainties: āra can mean spoke or petal in cakra imagery.
plain_english: One should contemplate a divine eight-spoked lotus adorned by the first octad.
